mapping: Pinned TEI Consortium P4-to-P5 migration; source divN levels become typed P5 div and adjacent mixed content is wrapped without reordering. Legacy links become P5 ref; figure entities become P5 graphic with original entity names and absolute provider targets. Invalid legacy page-identifier xml:lang values become ana references; blank page rend values are omitted; legacy language identifiers become ident; TEI.2 header status/type and misplaced publication place move to valid P5 structures. Payne embedded block quotations are represented as source-paragraph divisions containing ordered paragraph runs. All source text, heading, page markers, roles, and front/back content remain in reading order. In Holsey, 29 titled works become independent TEI children with shared front and two group shells represented once. In Heard, Ephraim D. Tyler’s separately authored Chapter Ten poem is an independent TEI child. The one source-attested title-page work, MY LIFE AND WORK, is represented by one P5 TEI root. All eleven retained JPEGs are bound as supporting source authorities and in source accountability; the fixed six-member CandidatePackage has no binary asset slot, so TEI graphics preserve original DocSouth URLs and visual display remains open.

provenance.method: Source-bound DocSouth TEI.2 to P5 conversion with independent Expat oracle.
